title: The tech's summer
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The tech says the machine idles all summer and so does he. He'll be here Wednesdays if Wood wants to keep running the digest. Wood asks if that's allowed. The tech says he hasn't asked. Different once.

panels.composition: The print shop. The TECH with the summer schedule pinned up as blocks. WOOD. BARNABY.

balloons.text: Machine idles all summer. So do I. Wednesdays.

image.prompt: a print technician beside a summer schedule pinned to a wall while a young man and a small dog stand at the counter, black and white, no words
a young man's face, careful, black and white, no words
a print technician's face, dry, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The copier, its light off, waiting for summer. The tech's hand on it the way Wood's is on the copies. Two men who talk to a machine. The strip sees the resemblance and doesn't say it.

image.prompt: a print technician resting a hand on a large idle photocopier while a young man watches, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Wednesdays all summer. 'Haven't asked.' Two men who talk to a machine.
